q: After Saul and Jonathan died, what did David take up for them?
why: David mourned his king and his friend.
quote: Then David took up this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan

q: After Saul's death, the men of Judah anointed David king in which town?
quote: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah.

q: How old was David when he became king?
quote: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.

q: What fortress did King David capture, later called the City of David?
quote: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).

q: As the ark was brought to Jerusalem, what did King David do before the LORD?
quote: And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD

q: Why was King David troubled about his cedar house?
a: God's ark was in a tent
why: He wanted to build a house for God.
quote: Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.

q: What did God promise about King David's throne?
quote: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.

q: For whose sake did King David want to show kindness to Saul's family?
why: Jonathan had been his loyal friend.
quote: Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?

q: What did King David promise Jonathan's lame son Mephibosheth?
a: To always eat at his table
why: David kept his promise to Jonathan.
quote: and you will always eat at my table.

q: Which prophet did the LORD send to King David after his sin with Bathsheba?
why: He told a story to show David his sin.
quote: Then the LORD sent Nathan to David

q: In Nathan's story to David, what did the poor man own?
quote: but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought.

q: After his story about the stolen lamb, what did Nathan tell David?
quote: You are that man!

q: When confronted by Nathan, what did King David confess?
a: I have sinned against the LORD
quote: I have sinned against the LORD.

q: What did David and Bathsheba name the son the LORD loved?
quote: So she gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. Now the LORD loved the child

q: In his song of praise, what did King David call the LORD?
quote: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

q: In David's lament, Saul and Jonathan were swifter than what?
why: They were also stronger than lions.
quote: They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

q: During the long war between Saul's house and David's house, who grew stronger?
quote: And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.

q: Which people held Jerusalem before King David captured it?
why: They said David could never get in.
quote: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.

q: Which king sent cedar logs and builders to build King David's palace?
quote: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons

q: Whose house was blessed while God's ark stayed there before going to Jerusalem?
why: Then David brought the ark up with joy.
quote: The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God.

q: Who looked from a window and despised King David for dancing before the ark?
why: David was worshiping with all his heart.
quote: Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD

q: God told David that his descendant, not David, would build what?
quote: He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

q: What did Ziba tell King David about Jonathan's surviving son?
a: He was lame in both feet
quote: There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.

q: What was the name of Jonathan's son whom King David welcomed?
quote: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence.

q: Bathsheba was the wife of which soldier in King David's army?
quote: This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.

q: In Nathan's story, how many times over did David say the rich man must pay for the lamb?
why: David was angry before he saw his own sin.
quote: he must pay for the lamb four times over.

q: Which of David's sons stole the hearts of the men of Israel?
why: He turned people against the king.
quote: In this way he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

q: When Absalom rode under a large oak, what got caught in the tree?
why: He was left hanging in midair.
quote: Absalom’s head was caught fast in the tree.

q: What did King David cry out when he heard Absalom had died?
why: He wished he had died instead.
quote: O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom!

q: When his mighty men brought water from Bethlehem's well, what did David do?
a: Poured it out to the LORD
why: They had risked their lives for it.
quote: But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD

q: Why did King David insist on paying for the threshing floor?
quote: for I will not offer to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.

q: How long did David reign over Judah in Hebron?
quote: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months

q: How many years did David reign in Jerusalem over all Israel and Judah?
why: His total reign was forty years.
quote: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

q: How old was Mephibosheth when his nurse dropped him and he became lame?
why: She was fleeing after Saul's death.
quote: He was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel.

q: In which town was Mephibosheth living when David asked for him?
why: He was at the house of Machir.
quote: he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.

q: Who was the servant of Saul's family who told David about Mephibosheth?
why: He was summoned to the king.
quote: And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba.

q: How long did the ark stay at Obed-edom's house?
quote: Thus the ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months

q: In his last words, what does David call himself?
quote: and the sweet psalmist of Israel

q: How much did David pay for the threshing floor and oxen?
why: He refused it as a gift.
quote: So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

q: What was David wearing when he danced before the ark?
quote: And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD
